Books to read, each with a line on where it came from.

- Iris Murdoch, *The Sovereignty of Good* (1970). Moral philosophy built on
  Weil's idea of attention, and on the Good as a transcendent ideal sensed but
  hard to define. Came up in chapter 15 of
  [Will and Attention](books/will-and-attention.qmd).
- Meghan O'Gieblyn, *Interior States* (2018). Essays on faith, doubt and
  leaving an evangelical upbringing.
- Meghan O'Gieblyn, *God, Human, Animal, Machine* (2021). Technology, the
  mind and meaning, read through the theology she grew up with.
